title: The Wish Tree Grand Finale
location: The Human Rights & Poverty Stone, Dublin Custom House Quay
description: Join Children 4 World Children for the grand finale of The Wish Tree — Voices for a Poverty Free Future.
fullDescription: Come together on the United Nations International Day for the Eradication of Poverty to add your wish for a kinder, fairer world and raise voices for a future without poverty.
theme: Voices for a Poverty Free Future
highlights: Add your wish for a world without poverty
Celebrate the finale of the public Wish Tree exhibition
Mark the United Nations International Day for the Eradication of Poverty
audience: Children, families, schools and community members
